description: Returns a monitor's uptime percentage, check counts and ping (min/avg/max) over the last N hours, up to a year, with the minutes, hours or days in which checks failed, newest first. Use it for "what was the uptime this week?"; for the current status use getMonitorSummary, and for individual checks listHeartbeats. Counted as Uptime Kuma counts them: PENDING is down, and MAINTENANCE is neither.

hours.description: How far back, in hours (default: 24; e.g. 168 for a week, 720 for 30 days). Up to 24 is counted per minute, up to 720 per hour, beyond that per whole day.

monitorID.description: The monitor to report on. Find IDs with listMonitors.

name: getMonitorUptime

downtimeBucketCount.description: Buckets with at least one failed check

granularity.description: Size of each bucket in downtimeBuckets

uptimePercent.description: up / (up + down) × 100; null when there were no checks

title: Get Monitor Uptime
